First Appeared: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.u04lXzbSCHW2OEf7]{Session 3}
Status: Active
Affiliation: Independent

Description

A large mother rock rat living in the mine tunnels beneath @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aurelion}.
She has had at least three litters and her teeth can gnaw through solid rock.

Role

Provided @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} with intelligence about the tunnels beneath @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aurelion} — including warnings about undead deeper in the passages and rock rat ambush tactics — in exchange for his companionship.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} can speak with animals, which enabled the negotiation.

Relationships

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} — Mate; traded intelligence for companionship

Key Events

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.u04lXzbSCHW2OEf7]{Session 3} — Encountered @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} in beaver form in her burrow; bargained intelligence about the tunnels for his company
